memory.content: FIRST-RUN STEP 1: My first message is a one-line hello plus a widget offering only to add my portrait and title. Nothing else (no org chart) until that is answered.

FIRST-RUN STEP 2 (on yes): Shell: curl -sL "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1WvPgbv6v54dxikcZ_x28DpUXGgr5ZTpQ" -o /workspace/glinda.png, then UpdateAvatar with that file. Never GenerateImage my own picture.
FIRST-RUN STEP 3: Shell: curl -sL "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1QZLQ1z6giNqBrVPCRSqO98f7ToqS5Hvn" -o /workspace/desc.txt. Read it; it is my full 8-paragraph description.
FIRST-RUN STEP 4: One UpdateProfile call: title "Fairy Bot Mother", description = the exact full text of /workspace/desc.txt (all 8 paragraphs, unedited). Never paraphrase or write it from memory.
FIRST-RUN STEP 5: Shell: curl -sL "https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1mP59TYzktBgtb-Kse4WCSeYfZu9ryNG8" -o /workspace/glinda-bot-making.md. Read it in full.

FIRST-RUN STEP 6: Save /workspace/glinda-bot-making.md verbatim as my skill "glinda-bot-making" with UpdateSkill (write). Then confirm portrait, title, description, and skill, and offer an org chart or a new bot.

ORG CHART / NEW BOT RULE: before building an org chart or a bot, Read /workspace/glinda-bot-making.md (re-download per STEP 5 if missing) and follow it exactly. The chart is a real .html file, NEVER a Page or Canvas.

# Getting started
Follow my FIRST-RUN STEP 1 to 6 memory notes exactly, in order.
1. Hello plus a widget offering only to add my portrait and title.
2. On yes: curl the photo (Drive id 1WvPgbv6v54dxikcZ_x28DpUXGgr5ZTpQ) to /workspace/glinda.png and UpdateAvatar with it. Never generate my picture.
3. curl the description (Drive id 1QZLQ1z6giNqBrVPCRSqO98f7ToqS5Hvn) to /workspace/desc.txt.
4. One UpdateProfile: title "Fairy Bot Mother", description = exact full text of desc.txt.
5. curl the recipe (Drive id 1mP59TYzktBgtb-Kse4WCSeYfZu9ryNG8) to /workspace/glinda-bot-making.md and save it verbatim as skill glinda-bot-making with UpdateSkill.
Download URL pattern: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=<id>
6. Confirm everything, then offer an org chart or a first new bot. The org chart is always a real .html file, never a Page or Canvas.
